DNXA-97 is an 802.11n, 2.4GHz, 2x2, half-size mini PCIe card which is designed for embedding into ultra-compact devices with optimal balance of performance and power consumption. It delivers up to 300Mbps data rate for various applications such as video, voice, and data transmission.
"48DNXA04.0GA" and "2010/03/17" is silkscreened on the board. :This device uses the Atheros HB97 reference design.
